2.english_reference: To the chief Musician , A Psalm for the sons of Korah .

2.english_reference: LORD , thou hast been favourable unto thy land :

traditions.LXX: Εὐδόκησας , Κύριε , τὴν γῆν σου ,
traditions.KJV: LORD , thou hast been favourable unto thy land :

2.english_reference: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob .

traditions.LXX: ἀπέστρεψας τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Ἰακώβ ·
traditions.KJV: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob .

3.english_reference: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people

traditions.LXX: ἀφῆκας τὰς ἀνομίας τῷ λαῷ σου ,
traditions.KJV: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people ,

3.english_reference: thou hast covered all their sin

traditions.LXX: ἐκάλυψας τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν .

traditions.LXX: διάψαλμα .

4.english_reference: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath

traditions.KJV: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath :

4.english_reference: thou hast turned [ thyself ] from the fierceness of thine anger

traditions.LXX: ἀπέστρεψας ἀπὸ ὀργῆς θυμοῦ σου .
traditions.KJV: thou hast turned [ thyself ] from the fierceness of thine anger .

5.english_reference: Turn us , O God of our salvation

traditions.LXX: ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς , ὁ θεὸς τῶν σωτηρίων ἡμῶν ,
traditions.KJV: Turn us , O God of our salvation ,

traditions.VUL: et avérte iram tuam a nobis .
traditions.KJV: and cause thine anger toward us to cease .

6.english_reference: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever ?

7.english_reference: that thy people may rejoice in thee ?

traditions.VUL: et plebs tua lætábitur in te .

8.english_reference: Shew us thy mercy , O LORD

traditions.LXX: δεῖξον ἡμῖν , Κύριε , τὸ ἔλεός σου ,

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ יֶשְׁעֲ ךָ֗ תִּתֶּן לָֽ נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ σωτήριόν σου , Κύριε , δῴης ἡμῖν .
traditions.KJV: and grant us thy salvation .

9.english_reference: I will hear what God the LORD will speak

traditions.WLC: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה יְדַבֵּר֮ הָ אֵ֪ל יְה֫וָ֥ה

traditions.KJV: I will hear what God the LORD will speak :

9.english_reference: for he will speak peace unto his people , and to his saints

traditions.KJV: for he will speak peace unto his people , and to his saints :

9.english_reference: but let them not turn again to folly

traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς ἐπιστρέφοντας πρὸς αὐτὸν καρδίαν .

traditions.KJV: but let them not turn again to folly .

11.english_reference: righteousness and peace have kissed [ each other ]

traditions.KJV: righteousness and peace have kissed [ each other ] .

traditions.LXX: ἀλήθεια ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἀνέτειλεν ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ δικαιοσύνη ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν .
traditions.KJV: and righteousness shall look down from heaven .
